hindi: हम तुम्हें गणों के गणपति, कवियों के कवि और अत्यन्त यशस्वी को बुलाते हैं। हे ब्रह्मणस्पति, ब्रह्म-वचनों के श्रेष्ठ राजा, हमारी सुनते हुए अपनी सहायताओं के साथ आओ और आसन पर बैठो।
english: We call you, lord of the hosts, the seer of seers, the most famed, the chief king of the sacred utterances; O Brahmaṇaspati, hearing us, come with your helps and sit on the seat.
notes: brahman (n.) is taken as 'sacred utterance'. ā ... sīda is taken together ('come and sit'). The phrase gaṇānāṃ gaṇapatim is rendered 'lord of the hosts'. upama-śravastama 'most famed' (literally of highest fame).
lines_deva: ग॒णानां॑ त्वा ग॒णप॑तिं हवामहे क॒विं क॑वी॒नामु॑प॒मश्र॑वस्तमम्
ज्ये॒ष्ठ॒राजं॒ ब्रह्म॑णां ब्रह्मणस्पत॒ आ न॑: शृ॒ण्वन्नू॒तिभि॑: सीद॒ साद॑नम्
lines_iast: ga̱ṇānā̭ṃ tvā ga̱ṇapa̭tiṃ havāmahe ka̱viṃ ka̭vī̱nāmṷpa̱maśra̭vastamam
jye̱ṣṭha̱rāja̱ṃ brahma̭ṇāṃ brahmaṇaspata̱ ā na̭: śṛ̱ṇvannū̱tibhi̭: sīda̱ sāda̭nam

hindi: हे बृहस्पति, देव भी तुम्हारी प्रभु-शक्ति से प्रज्ञावान् होकर यज्ञ के योग्य भाग को प्राप्त हुए हैं। किरणों के समान और प्रकाश से सूर्य के समान तुम सब ब्रह्म-वचनों के महान् जनक हो।
english: Even the gods, wise through your lordly power, O Bṛhaspati, have attained the share fit for sacrifice. Like the rays, like the sun with its light, you are the great begetter of all the sacred utterances.
notes: te asurya is uncertain: asurya (n.) 'lordly power' taken as instrumental ('through your lordly power'); it could also be a vocative-like address. usrā iva sūryo jyotiṣā is elliptical; the comparison 'like the rays, like the sun with its light' is a literal reading and the exact construction of usrāḥ is doubtful. maho taken as 'great' agreeing with janitā.
lines_deva: दे॒वाश्चि॑त् ते असुर्य॒ प्रचे॑तसो॒ बृह॑स्पते य॒ज्ञियं॑ भा॒गमा॑नशुः
उ॒स्रा इ॑व॒ सूर्यो॒ ज्योति॑षा म॒हो विश्वे॑षा॒मिज्ज॑नि॒ता ब्रह्म॑णामसि
lines_iast: de̱vāści̭t te asurya̱ pracḙtaso̱ bṛha̭spate ya̱jñiya̭ṃ bhā̱gamā̭naśuḥ
u̱srā i̭va̱ sūryo̱ jyoti̭ṣā ma̱ho viśvḙṣā̱mijja̭ni̱tā brahma̭ṇāmasi

hindi: निन्दाओं और अन्धकारों को दूर हटाकर तुम ऋत के प्रकाशमान रथ पर आरूढ़ होते हो — हे बृहस्पति, उस भयंकर, शत्रुओं को कुचलने वाले, राक्षसों को मारने वाले, गोष्ठ को तोड़ने वाले और प्रकाश को पाने वाले रथ पर।
english: Having driven away slanders and darknesses, you mount the light-filled chariot of order — O Bṛhaspati, the fearsome one that harms the foes, slays the Rakṣases, splits the cattle-pen and finds the light.
notes: The four epithets of line 2 are accusatives agreeing with ratham (the chariot); they could also be read as epithets of Bṛhaspati in a different construction, but the case points to the chariot. pari-rāp 'slander' (from √rap 'chatter') is doubtful. ā ... tiṣṭhasi 'mount'. gotra 'cattle-pen' (also 'family').
lines_deva: आ वि॒बाध्या॑ परि॒राप॒स्तमां॑सि च॒ ज्योति॑ष्मन्तं॒ रथ॑मृ॒तस्य॑ तिष्ठसि
बृह॑स्पते भी॒मम॑मित्र॒दम्भ॑नं रक्षो॒हणं॑ गोत्र॒भिदं॑ स्व॒र्विद॑म्
lines_iast: ā vi̱bādhyā̭ pari̱rāpa̱stamā̭ṃsi ca̱ jyoti̭ṣmanta̱ṃ ratha̭mṛ̱tasya̭ tiṣṭhasi
bṛha̭spate bhī̱mama̭mitra̱dambha̭naṃ rakṣo̱haṇa̭ṃ gotra̱bhida̭ṃ sva̱rvida̭m

hindi: तुम उत्तम नीति से मार्ग दिखाते और उस मनुष्य की रक्षा करते हो जो तुम्हारी पूजा करे; उसे संकट नहीं पहुँचता। हे बृहस्पति, ब्रह्म से द्वेष करने वालों को तपाने वाले होकर तुम क्रोध जगाते हो; तुम्हारी वह महिमा महान् है।
english: With good guidance you lead and protect the person who worships you; distress does not reach him. Scorcher of the haters of sacred utterance, you rouse your wrath, O Bṛhaspati; great is that greatness of yours.

text_flags.why: possible: the Vedic 2 sg. middle of √īr would be īrase; the printed form is īrasi, which is also a possible active form

notes: The printed form īrasi is read as 2 sg. of √īr (rouse); see text_flags. Whether brahmadviṣaḥ is the object of tapanaḥ or of the verb is not fully clear.
lines_deva: सु॒नी॒तिभि॑र्नयसि॒ त्राय॑से॒ जनं॒ यस्तुभ्यं॒ दाशा॒न्न तमंहो॑ अश्नवत्
ब्र॒ह्म॒द्विष॒स्तप॑नो मन्यु॒मीर॑सि॒ बृह॑स्पते॒ महि॒ तत् ते॑ महित्व॒नम्
lines_iast: su̱nī̱tibhi̭rnayasi̱ trāya̭se̱ jana̱ṃ yastubhya̱ṃ dāśā̱nna tamaṃho̭ aśnavat
bra̱hma̱dviṣa̱stapa̭no manyu̱mīra̭si̱ bṛha̭spate̱ mahi̱ tat tḙ mahitva̱nam

hindi: न संकट, न कष्ट कहीं से, न शत्रु और न छल करने वाले उसे पार कर चुके हैं। हे ब्रह्मणस्पति, तुम जिसकी उत्तम रक्षक होकर रक्षा करते हो, उससे सब हानियों को दूर हटाते हो।
english: Neither distress nor trouble from anywhere, nor hostile ones, nor the double-dealers have overcome him. All harms you drive away from him whom you guard as a good protector, O Brahmaṇaspati.
notes: Line 1 has one main verb (titiruḥ) for a series of negatives; the first two subjects (aṃhaḥ, duritam) have no verb of their own, so the translation lets 'overcome' stand over the whole line, which is a smoothing of the construction. arāti 'hostile one' (also 'miser'); dvayāvin 'double-dealing'. dhvaras 'harm' (literally crookedness).
lines_deva: न तमंहो॒ न दु॑रि॒तं कुत॑श्च॒न नारा॑तयस्तितिरु॒र्न द्व॑या॒विन॑:
विश्वा॒ इद॑स्माद् ध्व॒रसो॒ वि बा॑धसे॒ यं सु॑गो॒पा रक्ष॑सि ब्रह्मणस्पते
lines_iast: na tamaṃho̱ na dṷri̱taṃ kuta̭śca̱na nārā̭tayastitiru̱rna dva̭yā̱vina̭:
viśvā̱ ida̭smād dhva̱raso̱ vi bā̭dhase̱ yaṃ sṷgo̱pā rakṣa̭si brahmaṇaspate

hindi: तुम हमारे रक्षक, मार्ग बनाने वाले और दूर तक देखने वाले हो; तुम्हारे व्रत के लिए हम विचारों से स्तुति करते हैं। हे बृहस्पति, जो हमारे विरुद्ध कुटिलता रखता है, उसे उसकी अपनी जलती हुई दुर्दशा कुचल दे।
english: You are our guardian, maker of the path, far-seeing; for your ordinance we praise with thoughts. O Bṛhaspati, whoever has set crookedness against us, may his own burning evil crush him.
notes: hvaraḥ taken as 'crookedness' (also 'the crooked one'). duḥśunā 'evil' (literally ill-luck) and harasvatī 'burning' are doubtful; marmartu is an intensive of √mṛ 'crush' (uncertain). vi-cakṣaṇa 'far-seeing' (also 'discerning').
lines_deva: त्वं नो॑ गो॒पाः प॑थि॒कृद् वि॑चक्ष॒णस्तव॑ व्र॒ताय॑ म॒तिभि॑र्जरामहे
बृह॑स्पते॒ यो नो॑ अ॒भि ह्वरो॑ द॒धे स्वा तं म॑र्मर्तु दु॒च्छुना॒ हर॑स्वती
lines_iast: tvaṃ no̭ go̱pāḥ pa̭thi̱kṛd vi̭cakṣa̱ṇastava̭ vra̱tāya̭ ma̱tibhi̭rjarāmahe
bṛha̭spate̱ yo no̭ a̱bhi hvaro̭ da̱dhe svā taṃ ma̭rmartu du̱cchunā̱ hara̭svatī

words.gloss: for the feast of the gods

hindi: अथवा जो शत्रुतापूर्ण मनुष्य हम निर्दोषों को सताए, या सानुक भेड़िया — हे बृहस्पति, उसे मार्ग से हटा दो और इस देवों के भोज के लिए हमारा मार्ग सुगम करो।
english: Or the hostile mortal who would harm us, the guiltless, the sānuka wolf — O Bṛhaspati, turn him away from the path, and make an easy way for us for this feast of the gods.
notes: sānukaḥ is an unclear epithet (left untranslated). The first line is a relative clause with a loosely attached 'wolf'; the translation keeps it as an apposition. deva-vīti 'feast of the gods' (also 'invitation of the gods'); asyai (f. dat.) agrees with devavītaye and is rendered 'this'.
lines_deva: उ॒त वा॒ यो नो॑ म॒र्चया॒दना॑गसो ऽराती॒वा मर्त॑: सानु॒को वृक॑:
बृह॑स्पते॒ अप॒ तं व॑र्तया प॒थः सु॒गं नो॑ अ॒स्यै दे॒ववी॑तये कृधि
lines_iast: u̱ta vā̱ yo no̭ ma̱rcayā̱danā̭gaso 'rātī̱vā marta̭: sānu̱ko vṛka̭:
bṛha̭spate̱ apa̱ taṃ va̭rtayā pa̱thaḥ su̱gaṃ no̭ a̱syai de̱vavī̭taye kṛdhi

hindi: हम तुम्हें शरीरों के रक्षक, हे उद्धारक, पक्षसमर्थक और हमारे प्रति मित्रभाव वाले के रूप में बुलाते हैं। हे बृहस्पति, देवों की निन्दा करने वालों को नीचे कुचल दो; दुष्ट लोग ऊँचे अनुग्रह तक न पहुँचें।
english: We call you the protector of bodies, O deliverer, the advocate, friendly to us. O Bṛhaspati, crush down the scorners of the gods; let not the evil-doers attain the higher favour.
notes: avaspartar is taken as a vocative 'deliverer' (avaspartṛ, uncertain sense); adhivaktṛ 'advocate' (literally one who speaks for). durevāḥ 'evil-doers' is a guess at the sense (duḥ + evā); ut naśan 'may they reach up to' is doubtful. The printed 'avagraha' in 'havāma̱he 'va̭spartar' marks the lost a of avaspartar.
lines_deva: त्रा॒तारं॑ त्वा त॒नूनां॑ हवाम॒हे ऽव॑स्पर्तरधिव॒क्तार॑मस्म॒युम्
बृह॑स्पते देव॒निदो॒ नि ब॑र्हय॒ मा दु॒रेवा॒ उत्त॑रं सु॒म्नमुन्न॑शन्
lines_iast: trā̱tāra̭ṃ tvā ta̱nūnā̭ṃ havāma̱he 'va̭spartaradhiva̱ktāra̭masma̱yum
bṛha̭spate deva̱nido̱ ni ba̭rhaya̱ mā du̱revā̱ utta̭raṃ su̱mnamunna̭śan

hindi: हे ब्रह्मणस्पति, तुम्हारे सहारे, उत्तम बढ़ाने वाले, हम मनुष्यों की प्रिय सम्पत्तियाँ प्राप्त करें। जो हमसे दूर या निकट हैं, और जो शत्रुतापूर्ण हमारे विरुद्ध हैं, उन्हें कुचल दो, उन सम्पत्तिहीनों को।
english: By you, O Brahmaṇaspati, good strengthener, may we receive the desirable human wealth. Those that are far from us or near, and the hostile ones that are against us — crush them, without possessions.
notes: manuṣyā taken as neuter plural 'human'; it could be a form meaning 'for men'. yāḥ naḥ dūre taḻit: the construction is unclear (taḻit 'near' or 'at hand'); the antecedent of yāḥ is not stated beyond arātayaḥ. anapnasaḥ 'without possessions' (an-apnas) is a guess from the root; the relation to tāḥ is unclear.
lines_deva: त्वया॑ व॒यं सु॒वृधा॑ ब्रह्मणस्पते स्पा॒र्हा वसु॑ मनु॒ष्या द॑दीमहि
या नो॑ दू॒रे त॒ळितो॒ या अरा॑तयो॒ ऽभि सन्ति॑ ज॒म्भया॒ ता अ॑न॒प्नस॑:
lines_iast: tvayā̭ va̱yaṃ su̱vṛdhā̭ brahmaṇaspate spā̱rhā vasṷ manu̱ṣyā da̭dīmahi
yā no̭ dū̱re ta̱ḻito̱ yā arā̭tayo̱ 'bhi santi̭ ja̱mbhayā̱ tā a̭na̱pnasa̭:

hindi: हे बृहस्पति, परिपूर्ण करने वाले, विजयी साथी तुम्हारे साथ हम सर्वोत्तम जीवन-शक्ति धारण करते हैं। छल करने की इच्छा वाला निन्दक हम पर अधिकार न करे; उत्तम स्तुति करते हुए हम विचारों से आगे बढ़ें।
english: With you, O Bṛhaspati, the bounteous, winning ally, we hold the highest vigour. Let not the slanderer who wishes to deceive have power over us; praising well, may we advance with thoughts.
notes: vayaḥ 'vigour' (also 'food, life'). yujā 'ally' (literally yoke-fellow). abhidipsu 'wishing to deceive' (also 'wishing to harm'). su-śaṃsāḥ 'well-praising' could also be 'well praised'.
lines_deva: त्वया॑ व॒यमु॑त्त॒मं धी॑महे॒ वयो॒ बृह॑स्पते॒ पप्रि॑णा॒ सस्नि॑ना यु॒जा
मा नो॑ दु॒:शंसो॑ अभिदि॒प्सुरी॑शत॒ प्र सु॒शंसा॑ म॒तिभि॑स्तारिषीमहि
lines_iast: tvayā̭ va̱yamṷtta̱maṃ dhī̭mahe̱ vayo̱ bṛha̭spate̱ papri̭ṇā̱ sasni̭nā yu̱jā
mā no̭ du̱:śaṃso̭ abhidi̱psurī̭śata̱ pra su̱śaṃsā̭ ma̱tibhi̭stāriṣīmahi

hindi: न हटाया जाने वाला, वृषभ, युद्ध में जाने वाला, शत्रु को तपाने वाला और संग्रामों में विजयी — हे ब्रह्मणस्पति, तुम सत्य हो, प्रतिशोध लेने वाले हो, उग्र और बल में हर्षित होने वाले का भी दमन करने वाले हो।
english: Not driven back, the bull, going to the contest, scorching the foe, overcoming in battles — you are true, the avenger, O Brahmaṇaspati, the tamer even of the fierce, of the one exulting in strength.
notes: anānuda 'not driven back' (not to be repelled); ṛṇayā 'avenger' is uncertain (one who pursues a debt or guilt); vīḻu-harṣin 'exulting in strength' is uncertain. The first line has no finite verb; 'you are' in line 2 supplies it.
lines_deva: अ॒ना॒नु॒दो वृ॑ष॒भो जग्मि॑राह॒वं निष्ट॑प्ता॒ शत्रुं॒ पृत॑नासु सास॒हिः
असि॑ स॒त्य ऋ॑ण॒या ब्र॑ह्मणस्पत उ॒ग्रस्य॑ चिद् दमि॒ता वी॑ळुह॒र्षिण॑:
lines_iast: a̱nā̱nu̱do vṛ̭ṣa̱bho jagmi̭rāha̱vaṃ niṣṭa̭ptā̱ śatru̱ṃ pṛta̭nāsu sāsa̱hiḥ
asi̭ sa̱tya ṛ̭ṇa̱yā bra̭hmaṇaspata u̱grasya̭ cid dami̱tā vī̭ḻuha̱rṣiṇa̭:

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √man

hindi: जो देवहीन मन से हानि करना चाहता है, उग्र, अपने को वैसा मानता हुआ, शिक्षा देने वालों को मारना चाहता है — हे बृहस्पति, उसका शस्त्र हमें न पहुँचे; उस दुष्ट और धृष्ट के क्रोध को हम दबा दें।
english: He who with a godless mind wishes to harm, fierce and thinking himself so, wishes to strike the instructors — O Bṛhaspati, let not his weapon reach us; let us lay down the wrath of the evil-doer, the insolent one.
notes: śāsām is uncertain (gen. pl. of śās 'instructor' or 'commander'; the translation 'instructors' is a guess; 'commands' is also possible). manyamāna ugraḥ 'fierce and thinking himself so' is a free reading: 'thinking himself fierce'. vadhaḥ 'weapon' (also 'slaying'). ni karma 'we lay down' (ni-√kṛ 'subdue') is doubtful.
lines_deva: अदे॑वेन॒ मन॑सा॒ यो रि॑ष॒ण्यति॑ शा॒सामु॒ग्रो मन्य॑मानो॒ जिघां॑सति
बृह॑स्पते॒ मा प्रण॒क् तस्य॑ नो व॒धो नि क॑र्म म॒न्युं दु॒रेव॑स्य॒ शर्ध॑तः
lines_iast: adḙvena̱ mana̭sā̱ yo ri̭ṣa̱ṇyati̭ śā̱sāmu̱gro manya̭māno̱ jighā̭ṃsati
bṛha̭spate̱ mā praṇa̱k tasya̭ no va̱dho ni ka̭rma ma̱nyuṃ du̱reva̭sya̱ śardha̭taḥ

hindi: युद्धों में आह्वान करने योग्य, नमस्कार से पास पहुँचने योग्य, पुरस्कारों में जाने वाला, हर धन को जीतने वाला बृहस्पति — उसने सब शत्रुतापूर्ण, छल करने वाले शत्रुओं को रथों के समान तोड़ डाला है।
english: To be invoked in battles, to be approached with homage, the goer among the prizes, winner of every treasure — Bṛhaspati has torn apart all the hostile, deceitful foes, as one tears apart chariots.

text_flags.why: the digit 3 is the printed mark of a prolonged vowel; read abhidipsvaḥ

notes: The line-2 sentence is loosely joined to line 1 (Bṛhaspati is the subject of both). aryaḥ is taken as 'hostile' (arya 'lord, stranger' is also possible); abhidipsvaḥ 'deceitful' (also 'wishing to harm'). The printed digit 3 after abhidipsvo is the mark of a prolonged vowel, not a letter. vavarha taken as perfect of √bṛh 'tear' (uncertain).
lines_deva: भरे॑षु॒ हव्यो॒ नम॑सोप॒सद्यो॒ गन्ता॒ वाजे॑षु॒ सनि॑ता॒ धनं॑धनम्
विश्वा॒ इद॒र्यो अ॑भिदि॒प्स्वो॒३ मृधो॒ बृह॒स्पति॒र्वि व॑वर्हा॒ रथाँ॑ इव
lines_iast: bharḙṣu̱ havyo̱ nama̭sopa̱sadyo̱ gantā̱ vājḙṣu̱ sani̭tā̱ dhana̭ṃdhanam
viśvā̱ ida̱ryo a̭bhidi̱psvo̱3 mṛdho̱ bṛha̱spati̱rvi va̭varhā̱ rathā̭~ iva

hindi: अपने सबसे तीक्ष्ण तापक से राक्षसों को जलाओ, जिन्होंने तुम्हें, जिसके वीर कार्य देखे गए हैं, निन्दा के लिए रखा है। तुम्हारा जो स्तुत्य है, उसे प्रकट करो; हे बृहस्पति, निन्दकों को तितर-बितर कर दो।
english: With your sharpest scorcher burn the Rakṣases who have set you, whose heroic deeds are seen, to scorn. Make manifest that of yours which is praiseworthy; O Bṛhaspati, scatter the slanderers.

text_flags.why: the digit 1 is probably residue of a printed independent svarita sign; possible

notes: tapanī is unclear (taken as an instrumental 'scorcher', an unstated weapon); the line 1 construction is uncertain. ye tvā nide dadhire: 'have set you to scorn' (nide dat. 'for scorn/reproach') is literal. The printed digit 1 in ukthyaṃ1bṛhaspate is residue of a printed accent sign; read ukthyaṃ bṛhaspate. tat ... yad asat te ukthyam: 'that which may be your praiseworthy (thing)'.
lines_deva: तेजि॑ष्ठया तप॒नी र॒क्षस॑स्तप॒ ये त्वा॑ नि॒दे द॑धि॒रे दृ॒ष्टवी॑र्यम्
आ॒विस्तत् कृ॑ष्व॒ यदस॑त् त उ॒क्थ्यं१बृह॑स्पते॒ वि प॑रि॒रापो॑ अर्दय
lines_iast: teji̭ṣṭhayā tapa̱nī ra̱kṣasa̭stapa̱ ye tvā̭ ni̱de da̭dhi̱re dṛ̱ṣṭavī̭ryam
ā̱vistat kṛ̭ṣva̱ yadasa̭t ta u̱kthyaṃ1bṛha̭spate̱ vi pa̭ri̱rāpo̭ ardaya

hindi: हे बृहस्पति, जो कुछ स्वामी दूसरों से बढ़कर पाने योग्य है, वह मनुष्यों में तेज और संकल्प के साथ दीप्त होता है। हे ऋत से उत्पन्न, जो बल से चमका है, वह अद्भुत धन हममें स्थापित करो।
english: O Bṛhaspati, what the lord deserves beyond others shines brilliantly, with resolve, among the peoples. That which has shone from strength, O you born of order, that wonderful wealth place in us.
notes: Obscure. ati ... arhāt (ati-√arh 'deserves beyond, surpasses') and aryaḥ ('lord' or 'stranger, enemy') make line 1 uncertain; the rendering 'what the lord deserves beyond others' is tentative. dīdayat śavasaḥ 'has shone from strength' (the case of śavasaḥ is uncertain). ṛtaprajāta 'born of ṛta' (also 'born in due order').
lines_deva: बृह॑स्पते॒ अति॒ यद॒र्यो अर्हा॑द् द्यु॒मद्वि॒भाति॒ क्रतु॑म॒ज्जने॑षु
यद् दी॒दय॒च्छव॑स ऋतप्रजात॒ तद॒स्मासु॒ द्रवि॑णं धेहि चि॒त्रम्
lines_iast: bṛha̭spate̱ ati̱ yada̱ryo arhā̭d dyu̱madvi̱bhāti̱ kratṷma̱jjanḙṣu
yad dī̱daya̱cchava̭sa ṛtaprajāta̱ tada̱smāsu̱ dravi̭ṇaṃ dhehi ci̱tram

hindi: हमें न चोरों के लिए, जो छल के स्थान पर निर्दयी और ठग बनकर अन्नों के लिए लालायित रहते हैं। देवों का ओहते; हृदय में शाखा; हे बृहस्पति, दूसरे लोग सामों को नहीं जानते।
english: Not us, to the thieves, who ruthless and deceitful are greedy for food in the place of deceit. Of the gods ohate; a branch in the heart; O Bṛhaspati, others do not know the sāmans.
notes: Line 1 is incomplete in grammar (mā naḥ stenebhyaḥ has no verb; 'not to the thieves' is left unfinished). Line 2 is obscure: ohate is an unclear form (possibly from ā-√vah or ā-√ūh), vi vrayaḥ is unclear (vraya 'branch'?), and the relation to na paraḥ sāmnaḥ viduḥ is not established; the translation is deliberately literal and tentative. paraḥ 'others' and sāman 'song' are standard. druhaḥ pade 'in the place of deceit'. Confidence is low throughout.
lines_deva: मा न॑: स्ते॒नेभ्यो॒ ये अ॒भि द्रु॒हस्प॒दे नि॑रा॒मिणो॑ रि॒पवोऽन्ने॑षु जागृ॒धुः
आ दे॒वाना॒मोह॑ते॒ वि व्रयो॑ हृ॒दि बृह॑स्पते॒ न प॒रः साम्नो॑ विदुः
lines_iast: mā na̭: ste̱nebhyo̱ ye a̱bhi dru̱haspa̱de ni̭rā̱miṇo̭ ri̱pavo'nnḙṣu jāgṛ̱dhuḥ
ā de̱vānā̱moha̭te̱ vi vrayo̭ hṛ̱di bṛha̭spate̱ na pa̱raḥ sāmno̭ viduḥ

hindi: क्योंकि सब प्राणियों में से, हर साम से, कवि त्वष्टा ने तुम्हें उत्पन्न किया। वह ऋण-वसूल करने वाला, प्रतिशोधी ब्रह्मणस्पति, छल का संहारक, महान् ऋत के धारण करने वाले में है।
english: For the seer Tvaṣṭṛ begot you out of all beings, from each song. He, the debt-collector, the avenger, Brahmaṇaspati, the slayer of deceit, is in the upholder of the great order.
notes: Obscure. viśvebhyo bhuvanebhyaḥ pari: 'out of all beings' (pari with ablative; 'above all beings' is also possible). sāmnaḥ-sāmnaḥ taken as a distributive 'from each song' (the exact sense is uncertain). ṛṇacit and ṛṇayā ('debt-collector', 'avenger') are uncertain. The last clause mahaḥ ṛtasya dhartari is unclear: 'in the upholder of the great ṛta' is literal, and the grammar of the verse's second line is tentative. Printed sāmna:sāmnaḥ is one token.
lines_deva: विश्वे॑भ्यो॒ हि त्वा॒ भुव॑नेभ्य॒स्परि॒ त्वष्टाज॑न॒त् साम्न॑:साम्नः क॒विः
स ऋ॑ण॒चिदृ॑ण॒या ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॑र्द्रु॒हो ह॒न्ता म॒ह ऋ॒तस्य॑ ध॒र्तरि॑
lines_iast: viśvḙbhyo̱ hi tvā̱ bhuva̭nebhya̱spari̱ tvaṣṭāja̭na̱t sāmna̭:sāmnaḥ ka̱viḥ
sa ṛ̭ṇa̱cidṛ̭ṇa̱yā brahma̭ṇa̱spati̭rdru̱ho ha̱ntā ma̱ha ṛ̱tasya̭ dha̱rtari̭

hindi: तुम्हारे तेज के लिए पर्वत खुल गया, जब तुमने, हे अङ्गिरस्, गौओं के बाड़े को छोड़ दिया। हे बृहस्पति, इन्द्र को साथी बनाकर तुमने जलों के अन्धकार से घिरे प्रवाह को बाहर निकाल दिया।
english: For your splendour the mountain opened apart, when you released the pen of cows, O Aṅgiras. With Indra as your ally, O Bṛhaspati, you forced out the flood of the waters, enveloped in darkness.
notes: śriye 'for splendour' (also 'for glory/for beauty'). vi ajihīta taken as impf. of vi-√hā 'gape, open apart'. yujā taken as 'ally'. parīvṛtam agrees with arṇavam; nir ... aubjaḥ 'forced out' (√ubj 'press, force'). The printed token nirapāmaubjo has an odd character in the source (aṷbjo).
lines_deva: तव॑ श्रि॒ये व्य॑जिहीत॒ पर्व॑तो॒ गवां॑ गो॒त्रमु॒दसृ॑जो॒ यद॑ङ्गिरः
इन्द्रे॑ण यु॒जा तम॑सा॒ परी॑वृतं॒ बृह॑स्पते॒ निर॒पामौ॑ब्जो अर्ण॒वम्
lines_iast: tava̭ śri̱ye vya̭jihīta̱ parva̭to̱ gavā̭ṃ go̱tramu̱dasṛ̭jo̱ yada̭ṅgiraḥ
indrḙṇa yu̱jā tama̭sā̱ parī̭vṛta̱ṃ bṛha̭spate̱ nira̱pāmaṷbjo arṇa̱vam

hindi: हे ब्रह्मणस्पति, तुम इसके नियन्ता हो; सूक्त पर ध्यान दो और सन्तान को जीवन दो। वह सब कल्याणकारी है जिसकी देव सहायता करते हैं। हम उत्तम वीरों से युक्त होकर यज्ञ में महान् रूप से बोलें।
english: O Brahmaṇaspati, you are the guide of this; heed the hymn and quicken offspring. All that is good which the gods favour. May we, rich in heroes, speak greatly in the rite.
notes: asya 'of this' has no stated noun (the rite or the hymn); yantā 'guide, controller'. tanayam 'offspring' is singular but collective. yad avanti: 'which the gods favour' (avanti 'help, favour'). The refrain bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ is standard.
lines_deva: ब्रह्म॑णस्पते॒ त्वम॒स्य य॒न्ता सू॒क्तस्य॑ बोधि॒ तन॑यं च जिन्व
विश्वं॒ तद्भ॒द्रं यदव॑न्ति दे॒वा बृ॒हद् व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीरा॑:
lines_iast: brahma̭ṇaspate̱ tvama̱sya ya̱ntā sū̱ktasya̭ bodhi̱ tana̭yaṃ ca jinva
viśva̱ṃ tadbha̱draṃ yadava̭nti de̱vā bṛ̱had va̭dema vi̱dathḙ su̱vīrā̭:
